clips.title: The story
paras: Behind the canal shops, Cut-Throat Alley lies quiet and empty in Stormwind City. Reach it through the Shady Lady near the Dwarven District, where a paved courtyard ends at an unoccupied residence.

Cut-Throat Alley lies in a quiet corner of Stormwind, charted with the Dwarven District but apart from its forge fires and soot. No main avenue leads here; the only footpath passes through the Shady Lady, a small canal-side shop just south of the bridge from Cathedral Square. Beyond its door, a paved dead end holds stacked crates, forgotten barrels, and one empty two-story residence. Passing guards and ordinary citizens cannot see the alley, which stays silent amid the capital.
